title: stachys citrina subsp. chamaesideritis
intro: Stachys citrina subsp. chamaesideritis, commonly known as Greek betony, is a plant species in the mint family that has been used for centuries in traditional medicine. The leaves and flowers of this plant have been used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, anxiety, and insomnia, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Greek betony include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Stachys citrina subsp. chamaesideritis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as borneol and camphor, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
